description: This Java class 'WebSiteProperties' manages configuration settings related to website URLs, ports, hosts, and HTTPS enablement within the OFBiz framework. It provides methods to initialize from properties, entity values, or HTTP requests, and supports dynamic adjustments like port offsets.

classes.name: WebSiteProperties
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating website URL configuration, ports, hosts, and HTTPS settings, with methods to initialize from properties, entity values, or HTTP requests, and to adjust configuration dynamically.

methods.name: defaults
methods.description: Creates a WebSiteProperties instance with default settings from the URL properties file.

methods.name: from
methods.description: Overloaded method: initializes WebSiteProperties from an HttpServletRequest or a GenericValue representing a WebSite entity.

methods.name: addPortOffset
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with port numbers offset by the configured port offset, optionally applying to HTTPS ports.

methods.name: updateHttpPort
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTP port.

methods.name: updateHttpHost
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTP host.

methods.name: updateHttpsPort
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTPS port.

methods.name: updateHttpsHost
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTPS host.

methods.name: updateWebappPath
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated web application path, removing trailing slash if present.

methods.name: updateEnableHttps
methods.description: Returns a new WebSiteProperties with updated HTTPS enablement flag.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the WebSiteProperties instance.
